Sprint 29 · 07 Halving-Zyklen: die Zustände aus ADR-0059 und ADR-0060 SYNTHETISCH

Planning board 07 of Sprint 29, drawn on 2026-11-12 before any code, for the third sprint PR (ADR-0059, ADR-0060). It draws the states these two records add to the adopted I12 idea boards (../ux-design-2026-11-10-idea-i12/, boards 01–03), in the same visual language. The price line is the idea boards' synthetic series (public, rounded anchor points up to 06.10.2025, invented after, drawn dashed); the chain's heights and block times are invented. Every cycle figure is computed from that series by ADR-0060's rules: tops and lows as the peak and trough of each window's maximum drawdown, the 20 % anchor, parts, hull, agree and the four states. Dashed outline: new.

Decided by the records (drawn, not proposed): the „Halving-Kette“ choice with none, Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin, and a question before halving events are deleted (ADR-0059 §4, §11); no „Zyklen“ toggle without the view (ADR-0060 §1); the health line in the cycle bar with host and age, and „Kettenquelle seit ‹n› Std. ohne Antwort“ when stale (ADR-0059 §8); no shade where agree is null, whether one_price_relation or parts_disjoint (ADR-0060 §5); the count line „2 vollständige Zyklen, 1 unvollständiger; Kurse ab 09/2014“ (§12); the range „Zyklus“ reaching past today (§11).

Proposed here, the recommended option the default unless you comment: Q1 the field sits below the master data with its own help and the chain's health line (flip „Halving-Kette ohne Zustand“); Q2 the question is an inline warning in the dialog that names the count, and the save button says it (A; flip „Eigener Bestätigungsdialog“); Q3 a bound security with fewer than two confirmed halvings shows no toggle, as ADR-0060 §1 says, and the edit form says why (A; flip „Zyklen-Schalter ausgegraut“, which would amend §1); Q4 a refused own URL names its reason in the bar (A; flip „Quellfehler nur im ⓘ“), and the edit form shows it too, because without halvings there is no bar; Q5 a „Jetzt lesen“ button beside the health line for POST /chains/:chain/refresh, showing the 10-minute wait (flip „Kein Lesen-Knopf“); Q6 the state words „offen“, „läuft“, „erreicht“, „verfehlt“, with „· Fenster vorbei“ for window_ended (flip „Stand als Satz“, the idea boards' „Fenster vorbei, Kurs war im Band“); Q7 parts_disjoint draws the two parts inside the outlined hull (A; flip „Uneinig nur als Hülle“); Q8 a disclosure „Bänder und ihre Teile“ under the chart lists each band, part, n and reason (flip „Teile nur im Payload“); Q9 partial observations carry a „Teil“ badge, provisional ones „vorläufig“.

① „Halving-Kette“ in „Wertpapier bearbeiten“ recommended

ADR-0059 §4 and §11 decide a nullable halving_chain, written by the operator or an agent and never guessed, with the four choices. Proposed (Q1): the field below the master data, the select drawn open as a browser shows it; each option says where the halvings come from; below it the chain's health and what is stored. For Litecoin and Bitcoin Cash (no source, §2) the help says the halvings are entered by hand and that the height is checked against the chain's interval, and it counts the confirmed halvings against the two the view needs (Q3 A). A refused own URL shows here as well (Q4): on a freshly bound security no halving is ever written, so the view, its toggle and its cycle bar never appear, and the form is the one screen place left.

② The question before the halving events go recommended

ADR-0059 §4: unbinding or rebinding deletes the security's halving events in the same write, journaled and counted, and „the screen asks first when there are any“. A (recommended, Q2): choosing another value turns the field into a warning that lists what goes (confirmed and estimated) and says the journal keeps it; the primary button names the count, so one click confirms and nothing opens on top of the dialog. B: „Speichern“ opens a second dialog that asks. Flip: „Eigener Bestätigungsdialog“.

③ The cycle bar: binding and the chain source recommended

Not bound and too few halvings: ADR-0060 §1 answers cycles: [] with no_halving_chain or too_few_halvings, and „the chart shows no toggle“ (A, recommended; the reason lives in the edit form, ①). B greys the toggle with the reason as its tooltip, which needs a sentence in §1. Bound without a source: the bar has no source to report, so it says the halvings are entered by hand, with no „Jetzt lesen“. Health (ADR-0059 §8): host and age; the fallback named as „Ersatz“; stale after 24 h without a successful run, in the record's own sentence, plus the last host and time and that the halving estimate dates from then (§13 item 9 of ADR-0060: the top band's time stays as last read). Refused own URL (§3, url_not_allowed): A names the reason in the line (recommended), B says „Konfigurationsfehler“ and puts the reason in the ⓘ (drawn open). The same line carries wrong_chain („falsche Kette: Genesis-Block passt nicht“) and tip_behind („Quelle hinkt hinterher“). „Jetzt lesen“ (Q5) is proposed because §11 gives the on-demand run to API and MCP only.

④ Max with cycles on: the partial window and the count decided

ADR-0060 §1 and §12: the 2012–2016 window starts more than 7 days before the first stored close (17.09.2014), so it is partial: no top (before_first_close), and its low (152 $, Jan 2015) counts, marked partial. The hatched stretch is the window before the stored closes. The count line is the record's own wording, above the interval table, where every row shows its n and which observations come from the partial cycle (Q9's „Teil“ badge) or are provisional (the open window's anchored top). Today's n: Halving → Top 3, Top → Tief 2, Tief → Top 3, Top → Top 2, Tief → Tief 2, as §12 says.

⑤ Range „Zyklus“ today: one price relation, and the band states recommended

The next top's parts are Halving → Top (time from the next halving's window, ADR-0059 §6: 23.03.–17.04.2028, from the recent 2,016-block rate to the target) and Top → Top; Halving → Top borrows Top → Top's price, so agree is null with one_price_relation and the band carries no shade and says why (dashed edge proposed). Tief → Top waits until the 2024–2028 low is final. The next low's band (28,3 k $–76,7 k $, 04.10.–28.10.2026) is the hull of Top → Tief and Tief → Tief, with „beide Wege“ 36,1 k $–37,4 k $ shaded; its state reads „erreicht · Fenster vorbei“ (Q6). The disclosure (Q8) lists each part with its n, rule and state.

⑥ An open top that is not yet an anchor, and parts with too few observations recommended

The same series as it stood on 10.02.2025, to show the state (the app itself reads today only, ADR-0060 §10). The 2024 window's maximum drawdown so far is −18 %, short of the 20 % anchor (§2), so its top is drawn hollow as „Top bisher“ and Top → Tief answers no_top_yet. Top → Top has one observation (2017 → 2021; the 2013 top is before the series), so it is absent with too_few_observations, and so is Halving → Top, whose price it borrows. The next top is then Tief → Top alone (n = 2, one end in the partial window): one_price_relation again. Finding: here the next low's band ends after the next top's, so §11's „Zyklus“ range (to four months after the end of the top band) would cut the low band off; the frame runs to four months after the later of the two (flip „Zyklus bis zum Top-Band“). Two gaps the record leaves, filled here: §5 names one_price_relation for the top band only; here the next low also has a single part with a price side of its own, and the board gives it the same reason (proposed wording for §5: „fewer than two parts with a price side of their own“). §4 does not say whether Halving → Top is absent when the Top → Top part it borrows from is; the board treats it as absent, with the lender's n. One more case of §13 item 4 shows on the same series: five days later (15.02.2025) the drawdown reaches −21 %, the December 2024 top anchors, and the October 2025 top replaces it.

⑦ Parts that do not agree: parts_disjoint recommended

On today's series the two ways to the next low overlap (36,1 k $–37,4 k $). To draw parts_disjoint, this frame uses a what-if variant: every close from 01.06.2025 on scaled by 0.9, so the open window's top is about 113 k $. Top → Tief then ends below where Tief → Tief begins, agree is null, and the hull spans both and the gap. A (recommended, Q7): the hull as an outline with the two parts filled inside, so the gap reads as „no way leads here“. B: the hull filled like any band, with the reason in its label only; it looks like one confident range. Flip: „Uneinig nur als Hülle“.

⑧ The cycle bar at 390 px recommended

The toolbar wraps as today; „Zyklus“ joins the range buttons. In the bar, each label starts its own line, the switches wrap, and the health line wraps under them with „Jetzt lesen“ at its end. Stale, refused (A) and by hand at the same width.
